_comment: D-71 ratchet baseline (2 Oct 2026; extended to all three engines 14 Oct 2026, bridge note step 2).
The headline terminal is excess-return convergence over the declared decay horizon. The pairs below
have NO declared decay horizon and so fall back to Gordon -- a gap the five-forces work owes
(analyses/dnl/five_forces_driver_gap_audit_2026-09-25.md; bridge note step 3), not a choice.
The list may only SHRINK: a pair that gains a decay horizon must be removed, and a new fallback
fails tests/dcf/test_terminal_form.py. WBC (bank: ROE converging to Ke on closing equity) and
CSL (segment: return on the D-67 capital base converging to Ke) route through the form from
14 Oct 2026; all twelve of their pairs are gaps today because no decay horizon is declared for
14 Oct 2026: DNL Fragmentation and Stagflation declared (10-15y, scale + switching_cost; design/frameworks/decay_horizon_checklist.md) -- all six DNL pairs now converge. The DNL list is empty.

14 Oct 2026: WBC x6 declared INDEFINITE (regulatory + scale + switching_cost, finite sensitivity 20-30y), ratified by Stephen; convergence_years = inf reproduces the justified price-to-book exactly, so no WBC level moved. Only CSL remains.
